ledger.title: Discovery Ledger
ledger.headerWithProject: {name} — the accumulated investigation state. Each run builds on this instead of starting fresh.
ledger.headerNoProject: The accumulated investigation state. Each run builds on this instead of starting fresh.
ledger.unavailableBody: Compounding discovery is an enterprise feature. Enable it on this deployment (SOURCES_ENABLED + the reflection flag) to accumulate a per-project investigation ledger across runs.
ledger.frontierTooltip: The frontier is the part of your data the investigation hasn't looked at yet — tables it has not explored.
ledger.momentumDescription: New findings per run. A falling line means discovery is converging — the project is well understood.
ledger.nextUpDescription: Open investigation threads the next run should pick up first.
ledger.grewOutOf: {count, plural, one {Grew out of this resolved thread:} other {Grew out of these resolved threads:}}
ledger.parentUnavailable: Parent thread is no longer available.
ledger.moreOpenThreads: {count, plural, one {+# more open thread} other {+# more open threads}}
ledger.decisionsDescription: Analysis-area changes the run proposed. Approve to apply them to this project's playbook, or reject.
ledger.coverageDescription: What the investigation has reached across the warehouse so far.
ledger.historyDescription: Playbook changes that have already been applied, rejected, or reverted.
ledger.settingsDescription: How the ledger is allowed to steer future runs — whether proposed playbook changes apply automatically, and which direction the next run favours.
ledger.modeDescription: Governs proposed analysis-area changes + self-directed next-tasks
ledger.frontierPolicyDescription: How the next run spends its effort
ledger.policyBreadthFirst: Go wide — explore new tables & areas
ledger.policyDepthFirst: Go deep — dig into the richest findings
ledger.policyBalanced: Balanced — a mix of new ground and depth
ledger.frontierHelpToggle: What do frontier, breadth and depth mean?
ledger.frontierHelpIntro: Frontier — the parts of your data the investigation has not looked at yet (tables and areas it has not explored). The frontier policy tells the next run where to spend its time:
ledger.frontierHelpWide: Go wide (breadth) — cover more ground: explore new tables and areas it has not touched yet, for a broad picture of what is there.
ledger.frontierHelpDeep: Go deep (depth) — keep digging into the areas already showing the strongest signals, instead of spreading out.
ledger.frontierHelpBalanced: Balanced — a mix of both: some new ground, some deeper digging. A sensible default.
ledger.findingsDescription: The full finding-level table behind the ledger — severity, status, and how often each has recurred.
ledger.findingsEmptyBody: Findings accumulate here as discovery runs complete.
ledger.decideDoneMessage: {action, select, approve {Proposal approved} reject {Proposal rejected} revert {Proposal reverted} other {Proposal updated}}
